source_snapshot.test_set: AMD CPU RAS -PCIe Poisoned TLP TX/RX Error
source_snapshot.procedure: Uses fixed 0:0:1/core3/port0 with pcieerror errortype 6 TX and 7 RX under ACS/AER, literal severity and SyncFlood settings, without defining OCP interface/service identity or a poison-consuming transaction.
source_snapshot.criteria: Calls both errors correctable and accepts tool PASS plus OS report within undefined timeout.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; generic logs cannot prove OCP target, direction, poison consumption or interface/service outcome and mix unrelated error classes.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: RPUC/CHANGED; adds OCP hardware/recovery gates but leaves copied tuple, flag semantics, actual traffic consumer, dependency isolation and deterministic severity unresolved.
source_snapshot.procedure_direct_xlsx: 【Before Test】 1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition. 2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.). 【During Test】 Hardware required: RDIMM with ECC Plug a NIC (Network Interface Card) device on a target PCIe slot on the SUT / HDT Software tool: AMD RAS Error Injection Tool 1. BIOS settings: a. NBIO Common options → ACS Enable: Enable b. NBIO Common options → Enable AER Cap: Enable c. AMD PBS → RAS → Pcie Root Port UnCorr Error Sev Reg: 7EF6030 d. AMD PBS → RAS → Pcie Device UnCorr Error Sev Reg: 7EF6030 e. FCH Common Options → FCH RAS Options → Reset After Sync-Flood: Enable f. NBIO Common Options → NBIO RAS Common Options → SyncFlood on PCIe Fatal Error: True 2. Unlock CPU via HDT. 3. Boot into Ubuntu 20.04/RHEL 2022. 4. Download the AMD RAS Error Injection Tool, then install and open the software. 5. Execute the following command to get a list of devices in the PCIe slots: sudo ./cmdline_amdraserrorinjectiontest --listpcieslotinfo 6. PCIe Poisoned TLP TX Error, enter the following commands: sudo ./cmdline_amdraserrorinjectiontest --pcieerror --sockdienbio 0:0:1 --errortype 6 --pciecore 3 --pcieport 0 7. PCIe Poisoned TLP RX Error, enter the following commands: sudo ./cmdline_amdraserrorinjectiontest --pcieerror --sockdienbio 0:0:1 --errortype 7 --pciecore 3 --pcieport 0 【After Test】 1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders. 2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria_direct_xlsx: 1. For correctable errors, the tool provides a PASS status. 2. If the OS reports the error within a timeout period, the test passed. 3. If the OS does not report the error within a timeout period, the test failed.
source_snapshot.deepseek_direct_xlsx: PARTIAL | -- OCP slot 1~N: inject the PCIe Poisoned TLP on OCP slot 1~N via the AMD RAS Error Injection Tool (after HDT/unlock + the BIOS RAS knobs from the procedure, e.g. Platform First Error Handling=Enabled + per-unit MCA/UMC settings). Agent stages/verifies with sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "dmesg -T 2>&1 | tail -160 | grep -iE 'pcier|aer|ecrc|lcrc|poisoned|fatal'; echo __PCIe_Poisoned_TLP_on_OCP_slot_1~N; ipmitool sel elist 2>&1 | tail -40 2>&1" but the tool injection step itself is interactive/HW-level and needs the user to drive the exact inject command.

test_case.test_name: OCP slot 1~N — retained controlled review-layer procedure
test_case.purpose: Verify Poisoned-TLP handling in transmit and receive directions for every required OCP slot, showing an approved disposable OCP traffic transaction carries and consumes poison while the expected AER response contains the event and the interface and dependent services recover.
required_package: OCP slot/module serial/FW/driver/interface/BDF to socket/die/NBIO/core/port map and distinct scope versus row 67
Management, storage, fabric and cluster-service dependencies plus independent OOB recovery path
Vendor proof pcieerror errortype 6/7 means Poisoned-TLP TX/RX and relation to einjbiopcie errortype 6
Disposable requester/completer traffic that actually carries/consumes poison with packet/I/O/checksum oracle
Exact AER source/status/severity and interface/service outcome per direction; correctable/nonfatal decision
Decoded 7EF6030/masks/DPC/SyncFlood, supported OS, timeout, aborts, RDIMM relevance and restoration
test_case.test_command: Inventory each OCP module, firmware, driver, interface, service dependency and NBIO/core/port path; prove pcieerror 6/7 direction/severity; secure independent OOB management; define requester/completer roles and disposable checksum-protected traffic; baseline AER/link/interface/service state; run TX once and recover fully, then RX once; correlate poison source and consumer outcome; verify no persistent data, link or service impact and restore all state.
test_case.expected_result: 1. For correctable errors, the tool provides a PASS status. 2. If the OS reports the error within a timeout period, the test passed. 3. If the OS does not report the error within a timeout period, the test failed.

safety_gate: Dedicated OCP path with independent OOB management and no production, persistent-storage or cluster-control traffic
Verify physical module and live tuple; never reuse row-67 tuple as proof
Use disposable checksum-protected traffic and restore known-good interface/service state between directions
Abort on wrong source, corruption outside disposable data, service loss, driver reset, link loss or fatal/DPC/SyncFlood escalation
No automatic retry; preserve evidence and restore/diff BIOS/HDT/AER/SyncFlood and module state
expected_evidence: Exact OCP module/interface/service and BDF/NBIO identity
Approved command direction/severity mapping and decoded AER policy
Disposable traffic roles, buffer/packet identity and integrity baseline
Separate TX/RX transcripts with exact AER source/status/severity
Consumer outcome and restored link/interface/service health without persistent data impact
Restored configuration and engineer verdict per direction
test_case.recovery: If an OCP module carries the only management or persistent-storage path, retain execution as pending until an independent channel and disposable consumer exist. Identical commands do not establish distinct OCP coverage.

source_conflict.reason: OCP slot 1~N uses the same single tuple as PCIe row 67 with no module/interface/service mapping or distinct coverage. pcieerror 6/7 direction/severity lacks authority, no transaction consumes poison, Criteria call it correctable without an oracle, and 7EF6030, timeout, RHEL 2022 and RDIMM relevance are unresolved.
